pca.caption: PCA of the 500 most variable features on published normalized signal. Features are centered, not variance-scaled. Each point is one biological sample. No sample was removed by PCA.

sample_correlation.caption: Pearson correlations across all 1245 finite, variable features on published normalized signal; fixed color limits from -1 to 1.

sample_qc.caption: Left: distributions of the analysis values, with extreme boxplot points omitted only from this display. Right: sample-level assay quality summaries. All biological samples are retained; individual samples are identified by name.

volcano_PM1_vs_Control.caption: Probe-level limma moderated t tests for PM 1 mg/kg minus saline, n=3 biological samples per group. Effect units are published normalized signal units, not an asserted log2 fold change. Orange triangles: BH FDR <0.05 across tested miRNA rows for this contrast; gray circles: remaining rows. Only the top-ranked feature is labeled. No additional log transform or normalization was applied.

mean_difference_PM1_vs_Control.caption: Mean published normalized signal versus group mean difference; linear units are retained, including negative values. Orange triangles mark BH FDR <0.05; gray circles: remaining rows. This is a mean–difference display, not a conventional log-ratio MA plot.

top30_heatmap_PM1_vs_Control.caption: Top 30 features ranked by limma BH-adjusted p value for PM1_vs_Control; rows are centered and scaled by their sample standard deviation for display only. Selection is descriptive and is not independent validation. Fixed sample order; no clustering of samples.
